blocks.text: Great leaders aren’t just measured by revenue spikes or expanding corporate empires—they are defined by the lives they transform along the way. For Jun Denoy Sy, founder of InMore Medical Inc., turning a bold dream into a booming global enterprise is proof of what happens when relentless hard work meets a huge heart. Roots in Cebu: learning the value of hard work Jun’s story begins with simple, honest beginnings in Cebu.
